instructions: Choose the ordinary keyboard keys to hold for the next half second. Movement, turning, one action and one weapon slot can be combined. Use the latest screenshot and the actual input history.

move.instructions: This group holds the movement keys.

forward_left.description: Hold W and A to move forward and left.

forward_right.description: Hold W and D to move forward and right.

back_left.description: Hold S and A to move backward and left.

back_right.description: Hold S and D to move backward and right.

look.instructions: This group holds the arrow keys that turn the view.

steady.description: Hold no arrow key, so the view does not turn.

turn_left.description: Hold the Left arrow key to turn the view left.

turn_right.description: Hold the Right arrow key to turn the view right.

look_up.description: Hold the Up arrow key to look up.

look_down.description: Hold the Down arrow key to look down.

act.instructions: This group holds one action key.

fire.description: Hold J to fire the equipped weapon; a held key repeats automatic fire.

shove.description: Hold K to shove nearby enemies.

use.description: Hold E to use, pick up, open or press the object under the crosshair.

reload.description: Hold R to reload the equipped weapon.

weapon.instructions: This group presses a weapon slot key.

keep.description: Press no slot key and keep the equipped item.

slot1.description: Press 1 to equip the primary weapon.

slot2.description: Press 2 to equip the secondary weapon or melee weapon.

slot3.description: Press 3 to equip the throwable item.

slot4.description: Press 4 to equip the health item.

slot5.description: Press 5 to equip pills or adrenaline.
